name: package_types_with_route_links
note: StockPackageType package_use plus the route_ids link count (addons/stock/models/stock_package_type.py:40), the m2m batch picking filters on; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT p.id, p.package_use, count(r.stock_route_id) AS routes FROM stock_package_type p LEFT JOIN stock_package_type_stock_route_rel r ON r.stock_package_type_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id
